verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native rule engine where a user defines event-based triggers that run actions inside Notion. Webhooks and API connections ([notion-docs-3], [notion-docs-20], [notion-docs-9]) only push events to an external endpoint, so a developer would have to build the rule-and-action logic. That makes them building blocks, not the capability itself. The Custom Agents material ([notion-docs-8], [notion-docs-22]) never documents event-triggered rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
